name: The operation that takes the units of a ring and returns the cyclic ordering that minimizes accumulated bond strain around the loop — the lowest-stress arrangement the same units can close into, the relaxed ground state selected from among every ordering that rings, so a material is characterized in its settled form rather than the first order that happened to close.

VINIT.justification: The collection of units exists as an unlinked bag without spatial or sequential definition.

TANCH.justification: The final state where bond strain is minimized and the system is thermodynamically closed.

AFWD.justification: The forward transformation of generating a specific linear ordering for the units.

AREV.justification: The reversal of a specific ordering back into the constituent units for re-evaluation.

CLINK.justification: The composition of the head and tail of the sequence into a continuous loop.

IMSCRIB.justification: The self-identification of a specific arrangement by its unique strain signature.

FSPLIT.justification: A single topological ring splitting into multiple distinct spatial conformers.

FFUSE.justification: Synthesizing the disparate conformer data back into the underlying ring identity.

EVALT.justification: Selecting the arrangement with the lowest accumulated bond strain.

EVALF.justification: Discarding arrangements that exceed the steric threshold.

ENGAGR.justification: A state where multiple arrangements have degenerate energy levels, held in superposition.

IFIX.justification: The irreversible logging of the settled ground state in the material characterization file.

steps.domain_action: Initialize the set of N chemical units without order.
Verify unit compatibility and valence requirements.
Generate a stochastic permutation of the units into a linear chain.
Perform the first ring closure to create a topological loop.
Branch the loop into all possible spatial conformers based on dihedral angles.
Identify the T-branch as the path toward lower enthalpy.
Identify the F-branch as the path toward steric strain.
Apply reverse descent to F-branch candidates to break links and retry.
Recombine the valid conformer metrics to determine total ring energy.
Hold states where multiple permutations result in identical strain within tolerance.
Periodically re-link subunits to explore neighboring permutations.
Select the absolute minimum strain arrangement.
Permanently fix the coordinates of the relaxed ground state.
Verify that the fixed state matches the target chemical identity.
Terminal seal of the cyclic structure in its settled form.
